mapper.select: SELECT C.CONTENT_ID, C.TMDB_ID, C.CONTENT_TYPE, C.TITLE, C.POSTER_IMAGE_URL, C.SYNOPSIS, C.CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT, G.GENRE_NAME FROM CONTENT C LEFT OUTER JOIN CONTENT_GENRES G ON C.CONTENT_ID = G.CONTENT_ID WHERE C.CONTENT_ID = #{id}
SELECT S.SEASON_ID, S.CONTENT_ID, S.SEASON_NO, S.NAME, S.OVERVIEW, S.POSTER_IMAGE_URL FROM CONTENT_SEASON S WHERE S.CONTENT_ID = #{id} ORDER BY S.SEASON_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT (TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, POSTER_IMAGE_URL, SYNOPSIS) VALUES (#{tmdbId}, #{contentType}, #{title}, #{posterImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{synopsis, jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT SET TITLE = #{title}, POSTER_IMAGE_URL = #{posterImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYNOPSIS = #{synopsis, jdbcType=CLOB}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TMDB_ID = #{tmdbId} AND CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_CREDIT (CONTENT_ID, NAME, CHAR_NAME, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{name}, #{charName}, #{profileImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO CONTENT_EPISODE (CONTENT_ID, SEASON_NO, EPISODE_NO, TITLE, SUMMARY, STILL_IMAGE_URL) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{seasonNo}, #{episodeNo}, #{title}, #{summary, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stillImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
INSERT INTO CONTENT_SEASON (CONTENT_ID, SEASON_NO, NAME, OVERVIEW, POSTER_IMAGE_URL) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{seasonNo}, #{name}, #{overview, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{posterImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
INSERT INTO CONTENT_CREDIT (CONTENT_ID, SEASON_ID, NAME, CHAR_NAME, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{seasonId}, #{name}, #{charName}, #{profileImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
